title: Whether the best musicians are also good people
summary: Johnston asks about superior human beings. Gil says every good musician he knows is a good person.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: It should be part of your archives, yes, yes. You of course, alone these many years have devoted these many years, have met many famous musicians. I'm wondering if there are some who stand out in your mind as just superior humans, as opposed to being musicians?
Well every musician I've known has been a good human.
We're speaking of the word human in quotes. I understand what you mean by human. Emotionally developed enough to get along with the next person.

Well that, but there are people who have outstanding personal traits. Sometimes we find people who are just considerate of others beyond belief. Who just have a natural instrict of recognizing a situation, a problem situation and coming you know, to the rescue as it were. But I think we know people who are just lovable for themselves no matter what they are or what they might be.

It's very hard to couple the various descriptions you have of a person. For example, some people who come to the rescue when it's necessary are not lovable. And whereas a lovable person may be lovable but he powerless to do anything for you. So it's hard to say.
I'm not suggesting that these, that these.......
No, but I'm just saying that's how it is and musicians are just the same as everybody else. They run the gamut of character stuff too. structure.
I know. That's the reason I was wondering who some of those were at the top that did stand out in your mind.
All the ones I know are at the top.
You're generous. (LAUGHTER). No, I mean on top of the character structure, line.

I don't know any, let me put it like this, I don't know any good musicians who are low (lifes?). (LAUGHTER). Creeps or whatever the expressions for somebody current specimens (specifically?) you don't like. I don't really know any good musician that isn't also a good person.
